subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a misspelt word.

The single most important factor that __distinguishes__ those of us who __succed__ in any __venture__ and those of us who don’t is this ‘instant coffee’ __attitude__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **succed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"succed"** is misspelt and should be "**succeed**". (सफल होना)

 
 
• **Example: **To **succeed **in life, one must work hard and remain dedicated.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Venture **(उद्यम): A risky or daring journey or undertaking.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to **venture **into the world of business despite the risks.
 
 
 
• **Attitude **(रवैया ): A settled way of thinking or feeling about something.
 
 
• **Example: **His positive **attitude **helped him overcome many challenges.
 
 
 
• **Distinguishes** (अंतर करता है): Recognize or treat as different.
 
 
• **Example:** Her ability to remain calm under pressure **distinguishes **her from her peers.
